assessment.summary: IL6R (P08887) is a well-validated, clinically proven drug target with two approved biologic antagonists (tocilizumab and sarilumab). Structural data is solid with 10 PDB entries at up to 2.4Å resolution and 8 ligand-bound structures, though the approved drugs are large biologics rather than small molecules, and ChEMBL IC50 data for small molecules is absent. The target is highly druggable at the biologic level, but small-molecule druggability remains undemonstrated.
evidence_gaps: No small-molecule IC50 data in ChEMBL despite approved drugs existing — approved drugs are biologics (antibodies), not small molecules
Best PDB resolution is 2.4Å, just at the threshold for 'high' structural confidence; no structures clearly below 2.0Å
AlphaFold mean pLDDT of 77.9 with only 67.5% high-confidence fraction suggests some disordered regions, likely in extracellular or linker domains
No evidence of small-molecule binding site characterisation or fragment screening campaigns
Druggability of the IL-6/IL-6R protein-protein interaction interface for small molecules has not been established from this data
Selectivity considerations over GP130 (co-receptor) and soluble IL-6R isoforms not addressed in available data
